g.text: 1. user should be able to create post
2. user should be able to follow people
3. user should be able to view a feed of posts from people they follow
(and this will be in reverse cronological order , newest first)
4. user should be able to page through their feed
1. system should be highly available (prioritizing over consistency)
- tolerate 1min of delay of post staleness
2. posting and viewing of feed should be fast (<500ms)
3. system should be able to handle 2bn of DAU
4. user should be able to follow unlimited number of users
Dynamo DB - will use this as its highly scalable and handle high throughput
and spead load across all partitions
Feed service - basic how it will work (this will cause fan-out on read)
first get all the users following
fetch all post older then the timestamp
what is fan-out on read - single request fan out to create many more request
when a user post it will create
precomputed feed for all the following users
-async worker with HYBRID approach (menaing will decide for which post we need to calc precomputed feed)
why ? for justin beiber we will need to create 90M precomputed feed , easy way to add a flag on follow
table saying is precomputed calc or not
- when reading feed will check for all the folow table which are not precomputed
and give it directly from the post based on timestamp and for else will use the precomputed feed
3rd problem - handle uneven read of post (hot key post table)
(why Dynamo DB not usefull as egv post 1 geting 1000 post per sec and post 2 getting 0 post per sec )
-add a distributed cache infront of DB with a TTL and LRU eviction policy
(instead of shared cache where each post lives on each node , will add replicated cache
where any cache can deliver any post
- this does mean in inital there will be N (no of instance of cache) miss and will need to call N to database
but this will be still less than millions of users calling
when a user post it will create
precomputed feed for all the following users
index on category , location, venue , performer ...
